messages:
jen: Quick sync — pricing page experiments. Need final copy for committed tiers, calculator math, FAQ update about enterprise discounts, and webhook routing for inbound leads before webinar on Mon. Any blockers?

mike: Can we show committed price per 1M tokens + monthly commit badge? last time CTAs got messy.

sara: Agree. My ask: add "Recommended for steady usage" microcopy under committed tier. Also toggle for monthly vs annual.

leo: From eng: calculator needs to call /pricing-estimator API. I can wire webhook to sales if we pass lead_type=commit. ETA Wed.

ashley: For FAQ, legal wants "pricing subject to change" line. PMs want clearer refund/overage language. Also we should clarify quantization/units (tokens vs requests).

mike: UI note: keep calculator lightweight — prefer sliders + estimated monthly bill. Avoid deep modal.

jen: @ashley can you draft FAQ bullets? @leo coordinate with @mike on calculator UX. I'll update webinar CTAs to point to calculator pre-signup.

sales-bot: New lead route created: /webhook/pricing-leads -> sales-crm. Tagging: source=pricing-page, campaign=webinar-mar. (automated)

sara: Quick copy suggestion for badge: "Commitment — Lower unit cost, predictable budgeting". Thoughts?

ashley: Looks good. Maybe shorten to "Commitment: Lower unit cost, predictable budget" (remove 'ing')

mike: LGTM. I can prototype slider today. will share screenshot.

leo: Dev note: need backend param for commit_tier_id; if absent default to metered calc. I'll add feature flag 'pricing_calc_v2'.

jen: Timeline: draft FAQ + badge copy by EOD Thu, calculator prototype Fri, eng hookup Mon. Webinar promo goes live Tue. If anyone can't hit these pls say now.

ashley: I can do EOD Thu.

mike: prototype Friday morning.

leo: eng slot booked Mon AM.

jen: perfect. thanks team :tada:
